lines.en: I'm only as big as one hand.

lines.zh: 我一步三回头，怕有人跟来。
lines.en: I look back every few steps in case someone follows.
My steps are too loud, so I soften them.
I edge along the corner of the wall.

lines.zh: 我走进草丛，就看不见了。
lines.en: Once I'm in the grass, I can't be seen.

lines.zh: 我躲在一只箱子后面走。
lines.en: I walk behind a chest.
I go around the fire; it's too bright.
I keep my wings folded tight.

lines.zh: 我踩到自己的尾巴，停住。
lines.en: I step on my own tail and freeze.
I wait a moment before going on.
Everywhere I go is dark.
I walk along the water without speaking.
I huddle in the corner and stay still.
I tuck my tail by my feet.
I've been here a long while.
There's noise outside, and I'm not going out.
I stare at the light in the den mouth.
Under this stone is just right.

lines.zh: 我看着自己的爪子发呆。
lines.en: I stare blankly at my own claws.
I dream that I'm flying.
No one is going to come looking for me.
I make myself smaller.
Dust settles on my back. I ignore it.
I'm not hungry; I'm only afraid.
Only when it's dark do I dare move.

lines.zh: 我听了很久，什么也没听见。
lines.en: I listen a long time and hear nothing.
You've found me.
Don't come closer; I'm not ready.
I lower my head behind the stone.
You walk very loudly.
Your hand is coming toward me.
I keep my teeth behind my lips.
Could you lower your hand?
My eyes shine in the dark.
You're standing at my egg nest.
Only breath comes from my throat.
Would you sit here?

lines.zh: 我在暗处看你看了很久。
lines.en: I have watched you from the dark for a long while.

lines.zh: 我有点冷，可以靠一下吗？
lines.en: I'm a little cold; may I lean on you?

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我的石头。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my stone.
I don't like bright places.
When you crouch down, I stop shaking.
If I call, will you turn around?
I've been hiding here for three days.
You're not frightening, honestly.
I've lifted my head — look.
A hot sting. My scales are still soft.
I do not even dare whimper.
The pain keeps my wings from folding.
I shrink back into the dark.
Small body, small dragon breath.
I didn't run; it wouldn't have helped.

lines.zh: 这块石头底下我记住了。
lines.en: I've remembered the spot under this stone.
I press to the ground and stay still.
Something on me is torn.
I edge a little closer to your feet.

lines.zh: 你放在地上的？我自己过去。
lines.en: You left it on the ground? I'll come myself.
I'll wait until you step back.
I can smell that much.
I stretch my neck out, slowly.
Do I have to retreat after one bite?
I wait for your hand to leave the ground.
Was this left for me?
I take it and back into the corner.
Don't watch me eat.

lines.zh: 原来你带来的东西是好的。
lines.en: So the things you bring are good.
I jump in fright.
I didn't mean to bump you.
I retreat to the corner at once.
Your sleeve brushed me.
My wing got squashed.
We collided and I curled into a ball.
Don't move; let me pass.
I've hidden behind you.
I press myself to the wall at once.
I am so scared my wings have gone stiff.

lines.zh: 另一只躲在另一头的缝里。
lines.en: Another hides in a crack at the other end.

lines.zh: 我这身鳞，是从箱子里带出来的。
lines.en: These scales came out of a chest.
I shift forward half an inch.
She shifts half an inch too.

lines.zh: 我们的尾巴碰到了一起。
lines.en: Our tails touch.
Neither of us spoke first.
She's even more afraid of people than I am.
Her scales press against mine.
This makes the cold days easier.

lines.zh: 外面有脚步声，我们都停了。
lines.en: Footsteps outside, and we both freeze.
I snatch it up and dart back.
This is soft; good for a bed.
I pile it in the corner.
I bite it once, carefully.
I drape it over myself.
I'll hide it first, then work out whose it is.
I hold it and curl up.
This one smells of you.
I'm not giving it back — all right?
It covers half my face.
Something is coming toward my hole.
It is inside now, coming this way.
It snapped a branch.
Every scale on me stands up.
I can't let it find this place.
I keep low, in the dark.
Its back is to me — now.
I rarely strike first.
But this time I must defend myself.
My throat is heating up.
I wait for it to take one more step.
I spread my wings a little.
It has caught my scent.
Then there's no more hiding.
I arch my back as tight as it goes.
This bite has to land right the first time.

lines.zh: 我翅膀还小，只够滑一段。
lines.en: Small wings; I can only glide.
It can't see into the dark.
I wait for its eyes to slide away.
One block closer and I leap.

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩在灰上，没声。
lines.en: My claws land on ash without a sound.
It's walking forward.
I cut in from its flank.
The fire burns in my mouth and I hold it.
I slip into a rock crack and wait for it.
It turned away again.
I count its footsteps.
My heart is going fast.
I won't back off this time.

lines.zh: 我贴在地面上不敢抬头。
lines.en: I keep to the floor and dare not lift my head.
Its foot is right there.

lines.zh: 我等到它迈步的那一瞬。
lines.en: I wait for the instant it steps.
The fire is already between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我只有巴掌大，也会喷火。
lines.en: Palm-sized, and I still breathe fire.
I launch out of the dark.
Fire sprays across its shin.
I bite and hold, claws raking too.
It shakes and I go rolling.
I'm up again immediately.
That bite found something soft.
I startled myself with that.
The fire's out; only smoke is left.
I retreat into the dark, panting.
It's turning to look for me.
I come out from the other side.
This time I bite its heel.
My teeth are chattering.
But I didn't run.
I'm in front of you — don't fear.

lines.zh: 这一下我咬得比上次深。
lines.en: That bite went deeper than the last.
The egg cracked in the dark.
I don't like it this bright.

lines.zh: 我第一件事是找地方躲。
lines.en: The first thing I did was look for a place to hide.
A bit of shell still hangs on my back.
I peer out through the crack.
It's big out there; I'm not going.
I curl myself into a ball.
This place smells unfamiliar.
I test the den mouth with my tail.
I shift one step, slowly.
I have wings, but I don't want to use them yet.

lines.zh: 从岩浆里孵出来，还带着热气。
lines.en: Hatched from lava, still carrying the heat.
The light only reaches the den mouth.
I'll wait here for nightfall.
I tuck my head in before I even open my eyes.
Let me see who you are first.
I won't cry out; that would bring someone.
This shadow is mine.

lines.zh: 火光太近，我的鳞片缩起来了。
lines.en: The fire was too close and my scales drew in.

lines.zh: 我摔下来，缩成一团不敢动。
lines.en: I fell and curled up, afraid to move.

lines.zh: 水淹过我，我拼命往亮处游。
lines.en: The water closes over me and I swim for the light.

lines.zh: 响声把我震得耳朵发麻。
lines.en: The blast leaves my ears ringing.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我旁边，我几乎不敢呼吸。
lines.en: The arrow lands beside me and I hardly dare breathe.
That light leaves me stiff all over.
I'm so hungry I can't even hide.

lines.zh: 白光一闪，我往最小的缝里钻。
lines.en: The flash sends me into the smallest crack.

lines.zh: 什么都摸不到，我在往下掉。
lines.en: I can touch nothing and I'm falling.
